findings.title: current_keyspace stored optimistically and never rolled back on failed use_keyspace
findings.claim: current_keyspace is stored optimistically and never rolled back (also at worker.rs:351, connection_pool.rs:1287); post-PR every new connection with a failed use_keyspace is discarded, so pools never fill, the refiller churns full handshakes against every node forever at max_fill_backoff, and pools drain to Broken causing nodes to drop out of load balancing.

findings.title: Shard-mismatch drop site still leaks despite metrics-balancing fix
findings.claim: The metrics-balancing commit fixes three of four discard sites, but the shard-mismatch drop at connection_pool.rs:994 still leaks.

findings.title: Refiller teardown still leaks, encoded by new test at :2011
findings.claim: Refiller teardown still leaks (the fourth discard site not fixed by the metrics-balancing commit), which the new test at line 2011 actually encodes.
